latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of TikTok Highlight Editor.
- AI-powered highlight extraction: upload your video and describe desired highlights, transitions, or effects.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads (up to 500MB); outputs TikTok-ready clips in 30-60 seconds.
- Simple authentication: automatic token generation with 100 free credits for new users.
- Easily check credits, session status, or export results via intuitive text prompts.
- Error handling and cloud-render pipeline fully documented for smoother editing experience.
